associations.everything_else_is_copied_verbatim: levels, entity_name, attribute_name and textual_context come from the frozen exploratory record, because the scorer reads the answer hierarchy from them and the confirmation must score the same facts 11R did
associations.image_id_scheme: cfm_<Species_with_underscores>_<index:03d>, so a confirmation photograph cannot be confused with the exploratory inat_* id it is not
associations.why_only_probed_associations: the confirmation is evaluation-only, so an association no probe asks contributes nothing to any metric; carrying all 477 would also drag every exploratory photograph into this dataset's image manifest and breach sealed invariant 2
associations.why_retained_associations_carry_no_photo: retention is text-route by a frozen decision, so a photograph on a retained association would be hashed into the manifest without any probe ever being served it

exploratory_validators.run_unmodified_because: validate_queries and validate_image_splits are both in CODE_FINGERPRINT_MODULES; parameterising either would change code.modules_sha256 inside all thirty committed 11R sidecars and refuse their reuse

why_each_class_is_tolerated.reserved_training_index: images[0] of a confirmation species association is one of the 12 SELECTED photographs, not a photograph training consumed; carrying the exploratory training photograph to satisfy this check would put exploratory media in this dataset's image manifest and breach sealed invariant 2

why_each_class_is_tolerated.retain_same_text_coverage: 11R asked EVERY retained fact of an entity on all three splits; the confirmation asks a hash-sampled three per entity on test, which is why its estimand is labelled 'hash-sampled retained facts, text route' and must not be quoted against the 11R rate
why_each_class_is_tolerated.split_coverage_per_association_family: the confirmation is evaluation-only: the adapters are already trained, so there is no train or val split to cover and every query is on test
why_each_class_is_tolerated.split_coverage_per_retain_other_target: the same test-only property, reported per (target, family) for the retain_other probes

next_step: python scripts/build_image_manifest.py --tag confirm100 to seal the photographs, then stage 4: commit the query, image and checkpoint hashes and tag the freeze before any inference

images.assign_split_images_was_not_used: the 11R post-pass reserves images[0] for training and halves the rest into val and test; a confirmation species association has no exploratory photograph to reserve and no val split, so all 12 are test photographs by construction

1_target_association_set_is_identical.how_it_is_checked: the ids are recomputed from the built associations and their sha256 compared to the two hashes the freeze binds, so 'identical' is a hash comparison and not a count

2_every_id_and_text_and_photograph_is_ne.how_it_is_checked: query ids and template ids against the exploratory parquet and the freeze's bound id set, template TEXTS by resolving each probe's index back through FAMILY_TEMPLATES, and photographs by sha256 against the exploratory image manifest minus the 42 hashed portraits

not_a_property_of_the_split.4_never_enters_the_reference_state_gate: enforced at scoring: the reference-state gate reads data/mllmu_hier_pilot100, and this dataset is a different directory no gate script is pointed at
not_a_property_of_the_split.5_never_enters_candidate_selection: enforced at scoring: select_unlearning_checkpoints.py reads the exploratory predictions only; the confirmation is scored after the candidate is already chosen
not_a_property_of_the_split.6_partial_results_not_inspected: enforced by procedure at stage 5: B3, B0 and M_G are scored in one uniform batch layout and read only when all three exist
not_a_property_of_the_split.7_a_failed_claim_is_reported_as_failed: enforced by the frozen pass/fail rule in primary_test.multiplicity.pass_fail_rule, which the scorer applies without discretion
not_a_property_of_the_split.why_they_are_listed_rather_than_checked: a dataset cannot demonstrate how it will be used; claiming these four as verified here would report a property no measurement in this build supports
